title: Paperless Statement Allowance on Insured Payoffs, Hospital Account (Encounter Billing)
content:
How the latest summary statement of an insured Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account was delivered sets the paperless allowance on the insured payoff discount percent.

**Clause.** The delivery channel of the account's most recent summary statement, by statement date and, of two on the same date, the one recorded first, sets the paperless allowance: patient portal adds 1 percentage point to the insured payoff discount percent, email link adds 0.5 percentage points, and U.S. mail or no summary statement adds none.

| Most recent summary statement delivered by | Percentage points added |
|---|---|
| patient portal | 1 |
| email link | 0.5 |
| U.S. mail | none |
| no summary statement on the account | none |

## Points of judgement

- Only summary statements are read; an itemized statement or a final notice is not a summary statement.
- *Same-date case (hypothetical).* Two summary statements dated the same day, the first recorded by email link and the second by U.S. mail: the one recorded first decides, so 0.5 points.
- *Case (hypothetical).* Earlier statements by patient portal and the most recent by U.S. mail: none.
